subject: Mobile Development
title: Digital Wellbeing and Screen Time Backlash
description: A micro-lesson that makes Digital Wellbeing and Screen Time Backlash usable.

hook.text: The average person spends 7 hours per day on screens. A growing movement says that's too much.

buildup.text: Apple's Screen Time and Google's Digital Wellbeing tools show users how much time they spend.

discovery.text: Dumb phone sales are rising. Light Phone and Nokia feature phones attract digital minimalists.

twist.text: The companies building digital wellbeing tools profit from the screen time they're measuring.

climax.text: The future of mobile may be about less screen time, not more — using phones wisely, not constantly.

punchline.text: The best phone might be the one you use less.

quiz.question: Why is there a backlash against screen time?
options: People average 7 hours daily on screens and seek balance
